entities.summary: Lawrence Edward Moten III was an American professional basketball player. He played three seasons in the National Basketball Association (NBA) for the Vancouver Grizzlies and Washington Wizards. He was an All-American as a college basketball player for the Syracuse Orange, leaving as the program's all-time leading scorer.
